Q1.rationale: Segment 11 states Confidential Information may include verbally conveyed information.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: Segment 9 states the Receiving Party shall not use Confidential Information for any purpose other than those stated in the Agreement.
Q2.label: Entailment

Q3.rationale: Segment 23 states obligations that survive the end of the agreement must survive for at least 36 months.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: Segment 21 permits disclosure required by law but does not require the Recipient to notify the Discloser.
Q4.label: NotMentioned

Q6.rationale: Segment 13 states the Receiving Party shall not disclose the fact that the Agreement was agreed or negotiated.
Q6.label: Entailment

Q7.rationale: Segment 27 lets the Recipient develop similar products whether or not the development uses ideas learned from the Discloser, which is close to a residuals permission.
Q7.label: Entailment

Q8.rationale: Segment 0 states the Agreement does not grant the Receiving Party any right or licence to Confidential Information.
Q8.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: Segment 17 permits sharing some Confidential Information with third parties including consultants, agents and professional advisors.
Q11.label: Entailment

Q12.rationale: Segment 16 permits sharing some Confidential Information with some of the Receiving Party's employees.
Q12.label: Entailment

Q13.rationale: Segment 0 grants no right or licence to Confidential Information, which is incompatible with transferring ownership to the Receiving Party.
Q13.label: Contradiction

Q15.rationale: Segment 18 states the Receiving Party may acquire information similar to Confidential Information from a third party.
Q15.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Segment 28 states the Receiving Party may create a copy of some Confidential Information in some circumstances.
Q16.label: Entailment

Q17.rationale: Segments 8 and 26 give notice of immunity for disclosing trade secrets to government officials or attorneys to report a suspected violation of law, or in a sealed filing.
Q17.label: Entailment

Q18.rationale: Segment 21 allows disclosure required by law or competent authority and segments 8 and 26 give immunity exceptions, so the no-exception claim is incompatible.
Q18.label: Contradiction

Q19.rationale: The NDA does not deal with sexual harassment or sexual assault disclosures.
Q19.label: NotMentioned
